_help: Every character a pet can grow into. See docs/ART_GUIDE.md. 'stages' lists the sheet used by every egg, baby and teen. Each adult character has a theme, a star rarity (1 = common, 3 = rare) and a sprite sheet from public/sprites/manifest.json. 'variants' are optional colour versions: each has its own sheet and a chance (in percent) of appearing; otherwise the pet uses the character's normal sheet. Adding a character is one new entry here plus its sheet in the manifest.
